title: West Woods Sweat Lodge
summary: West Woods is a contemporary Shinnecock ceremonial landscape. Its public description stays broad to respect community privacy and ceremonial knowledge.
map_geometry_source: Broad public orientation point for West Woods from prior WP broad-area polygon; not the sweat lodge, ceremony place, or private community space.
why_this_matters: Shinnecock ceremonial life continues in living community spaces, not only in historic records. Late twentieth-century accounts document the return and continuation of Shinnecock sweat-lodge ceremonies, including the role of Shinnecock community members and relatives from connected Native communities. References: John A. Strong, "We Are Still Here": The Algonquian Peoples of Long Island Today (Shinnecock sweat-lodge discussion).
